column1: # Characters data/qieyun_mc.tsv cannot read, and WHY. MISSING.md M-2.
# data/qieyun_mc.tsv itself is NOT modified: the CC0 original stays
# byte-identical and re-derivable, and this file sits beside it.
# THE MECHANISM, from the upstream source rather than from inference:
# nk2028/qieyun-data's 韻書/廣韻.csv prints 䰟 as the 字頭 of 小韻 483, whose
# 韻目原貌 is 魂. The rhyme group is NAMED 魂 and 魂 is never a headword in it,
# so 477 characters carry 魂 as their label and the character itself cannot be
# looked up. The extraction is faithful; the rime book is keyed on its own
# orthographic norm and a Song lyric is not.
# relation -- and this column is the whole point of the file. A refusal rate
# is uninterpretable until its causes are separated (doctrine 79, one layer
#   異體  a variant of this character IS in the table. Read `target` instead.
#         An INGESTION defect, and it is now fixed.
#   簡化  a 1956 simplified form. `target` is what it simplifies. NOT mapped:
#         M-2 measured that resolving these silently returns a different
#         word's rhyme wherever the reform merged two Middle Chinese words.
#         A refusal, and its cause is the SCRIPT.
#   後起  no 廣韻 headword and no warranted 異體, but present in the
#         平水韻/詞林正韻 tables. A refusal, and it is CORRECT: the rime book
#   混同  the character READS -- it is in the table -- but it doubles as the
#         simplification of `target`, so in a simplified text the reading
#         returned may be a different word's. Not a refusal: a hazard, and
#         the reason OpenCC is not the fix (M-2).
# WITNESSES for every 異體 row, and the standard is two:
#             granted; this notice is the (b) route). kSemanticVariant,
#             kSpecializedSemanticVariant, kZVariant, read in both directions.
#   FILTER    hulbji/couyun (MIT): the pair must share a (聲, 平水韻部,
#             詞林韻部). This is not "these are the same character" -- it is
#             the predicate the module actually needs (doctrine 60):
#             substituting one for the other CANNOT change the verdict
#             ltc.rhymes gives at 平水韻 or 詞林正韻 granularity, because both
#             sit in the same cell of both standards. At RAW Qieyun
#             granularity it warrants nothing, so readings() marks every
#             can be told apart from the two grouped standards.
#   Where Unihan proposes two targets that couyun places in different cells,
#   the row is REFUSED rather than resolved by a tie-break (doctrine 66).
#   The 19 pairs MISSING.md M-2 names are entered FIRST, with their named
#   target, so this file can be read against the register entry that motivated
#   it; 11 of the 19 are also proposed mechanically, and every one of the 19
